name: cpa
summary: Templates for accountants in solo or small practice. Covers the judgement calls that a workpaper records only as a number, plus a workflow pattern template and session log. The return shows the position you took. The vault carries why it was defensible, what else you considered, and what the client was told.

templates.use: A filing, election, or reporting obligation
Accepting, declining, rescoping, or withdrawing from work
A tax or accounting treatment that required judgement
Generic starting point for any client decision
What happened in a work session
